name: The Solitaire Hand Chain
subtitle: 14K Gold · Round Cubic Zirconia
summary: A delicate 14K gold hand chain connects the wrist and finger, accented with a round cubic zirconia solitaire.
description:
A delicate statement. An effortless kind of luxury.

An elegant connection between bracelet and ring, the Solitaire Hand Chain is designed to bring a subtle sparkle to every movement.

Crafted in 14K gold, a fine chain flows gracefully from the wrist to the finger, accented by a brilliant round cubic zirconia solitaire.

What makes this piece truly special is the freedom to make it your own. Replace the centre stone with a diamond, a coloured gemstone, or a meaningful birthstone to create something uniquely yours.

Beautiful worn alone or layered with your favourite fine jewellery.

The cubic zirconia version is $598 CAD in either gold colour. Custom stones are quoted on request. Other pieces shown in the styling photos are not included.
